checkpoints.quote: Jo Tan / partner manager – today (09-15): Confirm whether the escalation to Northwind has a named contact and a concrete delivery date. … If certs are not in staging by then, flag the release immediately so the 3.2.0 ship date or scope can be adjusted before the sprint-cutoff on 09-22.
checkpoints.reason: The escalation action is clearly stated, but the specific plan to ship 3.2.0 with the MTLS_PARTNER flag off is only implied (scope adjustment) rather than explicitly stated.
